name: PHP Security
summary: Runtime protection inside PHP: blocks webshells, command injection, malicious uploads and file inclusion even when the WAF is bypassed.
description: Builds and loads the open-source Snuffleupagus extension for each PHP version on the server and manages its rules from the panel. Each rule can block, only log (to test it against your sites first) or be off. Blocked and logged calls are listed with the script, line and visitor address, and trusted folders can be excluded per path.
features: Blocks webshells in upload and cache folders
Log-only mode to test rules safely
Every change tested, rolled back on failure
